name: Agent notes
summary: A small, hard-capped note store that the agent changes through a dedicated memory tool rather than its file tools, and that is injected whole into the prompt, usually at session start. Because the store is bounded, the agent has to decide what is worth keeping. Hermes Agent works this way: its MEMORY.md and USER.md are capped notes managed by its memory tool, not a MEMORY.md workspace.
how: Give the agent a dedicated memory tool with add, edit and remove actions
Store notes in a small, capped file or record shared by all channels
Inject the whole store into the system prompt at session start
Have the agent consolidate when the store is full
Pair with full-text search over past sessions for specifics
facts: Hermes Agent (memory tool with add, patch and remove actions)
Small capped store, written through the memory tool
Hermes: 2,200 chars for agent notes, 1,375 for user profile
MEMORY.md and USER.md, but capped and tool-managed, not a MEMORY.md workspace
Cheap and transparent, but limited by what the agent chooses to write
goodFor: One agent reachable from several channels
Low-cost memory without an external service
watchOut: Hard size caps force the agent to drop older notes
Mid-session writes may not appear until the next session
